note: Pass 2 subtasks only — every Pass 2 subtask present in this set was extracted; this house is NOT fully extracted (skipped pages were skipped on purpose). Read from the drawings: 2-storey workshop building (อาคารฝึกงาน 204/27), grid 1-9 x A-D = 32.00 x 10.00 m + a 1.80 m stair bay (9') at the right end, ground walkway 1.80 and cantilevered upper corridors 2.00 (B9 / B7) on both long sides, roof eaves 2.50, steel trusses on grids 2-4 / 7-8 over RC roof beams R1, RC gable frames (R2/R3/R4/R5/R6) on the end walls. Rows B/C have columns only at the end walls; 10 m transverse beams B3 (0.30x0.80) / B4 (0.30x0.90) carry the B2 lines. Footings F1 (end walls, 8) / F2 (rows A, D, 14) in two designs: timber-pile groups (16 / 30 piles Ø6" x 6.00) and a prestressed-pile alternative (1 / 2 piles). Page 06 (แผ่นที่ 5): footing plan, ground-floor and upper-floor beam plans (with S2/S3 slab marks), roof beam plan, beam/column/footing sections, pile notes. Page 07 (แผ่นที่ 6): steel truss members, slab sections S2/S3 + walkway slab, RC gable section, RC stair, revision note. Page 03 (แผ่นที่ 2): B9 cantilever and B3+B9 continuity details + notes; its two building sections (side_profile) were swept only for the grid master. Page 05 (แผ่นที่ 4): general specification list (notes); its architectural details were swept for the grid master only. Page 02 (แผ่นที่ 1): floor plans + door detail, swept for the grid master only. Page 04 (แผ่นที่ 3): elevations (no dimensions). Page 01 = the sharer's cover. Grid labels 1-9 / A-D are assigned (the set prints no grid bubbles). Poor scan: many marks and bar callouts are partly illegible — kept as printed with lowered scores and flags (label_partly_illegible / label_illegible_inferred_from_repeated_pattern / mirror end wall); not extracted: the 1:10 truss connection sub-details (plates, bolts).
